nodes.label: temporal_indexer_feature_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for temporal indexer feature modules. Tests: decay_functions_work (exponential half-life at t=half_life gives 0.5, linear decay at t=5/10 gives 0.5), markov_predicts_next (records a->b twice and a->c once, predicts 'b'), poisson_detects_burst (three events with last two within 100ms triggers is_bursty). Imports decay, MarkovChain, PoissonBurst.

nodes.label: temporal_indexer_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test for TemporalIndexer basic insert and retrieval. Tests insert_and_get_recent: creates a single TemporalTrace with DecayType::Exponential, inserts it, asserts get_recent(1) returns 1 item.

nodes.label: vision_encoder_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for VisionEncoder image encoding pipeline. Tests: encode_image_basic_len_and_norm (4x4 image produces 8-dim L2-normalized embedding), encode_bytes_matches_encode_image (PNG bytes path matches direct image path), parallel_encoding_matches (feature 'parallel', par==seq), gpu_encoding_fallbacks (feature 'gpu', GPU result matches CPU), grid_output_shape (2x2 image with 2 tiles produces 12-dim grid, checks red and green patch norms), pca_reduce_dimension (48 values reduced to 4), l2_norm_and_entropy (3-4-5 triangle normalized, entropy > 0). Imports VisionEncoder, image crate.

nodes.label: world_model_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test for WorldModel (base world model, not enhanced). Tests add_and_export: adds a 'room' state with JSON metadata, calls export(), verifies graph is non-empty.

nodes.label: unit_suite.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level unit test binary entry point. Declares `mod unit;` which pulls in the full unit test module tree via tests/unit/mod.rs. Registered as tests/unit_suite in Cargo.toml.
